Cubic Equation

Newton for one real root, then the quadratic factor. ~70 bytes.

keys
MODE→6→2

HK listings of a full Cardano cubic are ~126 bytes and need CMPLX. This compact exam version asks for A, B, C, D and an initial guess M, Newton-iterates to a real root, then deflates to a quadratic and prints the other two roots. Stop Newton when |f| drops below 10⁻⁷.

note

~70 bytes of the shared 680-byte pool. Create the slot in COMP; CMPLX if the quadratic factor has complex roots. Type ? → : ◢ Goto Lbl If Then from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).

formula
Ax3+Bx2+Cx+D=0

Program (one line)

basic
?→A:?→B:?→C:?→D:?→M:Lbl 0:((AM+B)M+C)M+D→Y:(3AM+2B)M+C:M−Y÷Ans→M:Abs(Y)≥10^(−7)⇒Goto 0:M◢B+AM→Y:AM²+BM+C→X:(√(Y²−4AX)−Y)÷(2A◢(−Y−√(Y²−4AX))÷(2A

Example 1: x³ − 6x² + 11x − 6 = 0

Question: Use this program to solve the case: x³ − 6x² + 11x − 6 = 0.

Given: A,B,C,D = 1, −6, 11, −6. Guess M = 0.

  1. 1 EXE −6 EXE 11 EXE −6 EXE 0 EXE
  2. First pause: 1 (Newton root). EXE → 2. EXE → 3

Example 2: Guess near a different root

Question: Use this program to solve the case: Guess near a different root.

Given: Same polynomial, guess M = 5 walks to 3 first.

  1. 1 EXE −6 EXE 11 EXE −6 EXE 5 EXE
  2. Pauses 3, then 1 and 2 (order of the last two follows the quadratic formula)

Example 3 (edge): x³ + x = 0 → 0, ±i

Question: Use this program to solve the case: x³ + x = 0 → 0, ±i.

Given: A,B,C,D = 1, 0, 1, 0. Guess 0. The quadratic is x² + 1. Run the slot in CMPLX to print ±i.

  1. CMPLX slot. 1 EXE 0 EXE 1 EXE 0 EXE 0 EXE
  2. First root 0. Next pauses: i and −i (R<=>I). In COMP you get Math ERROR on −1​
note

10^(−7) is the Newton stop. If f′(M) = 0 Newton hits Math ERROR — try another guess. A published Cardano listing (~126 bytes, CMPLX) prints all three roots without a guess.
